name: EMEET PIXY
author: Guilherme Teodoro
description: Control the EMEET PIXY webcam through emeet-pixyd from an Omarchy Quattro bar widget.

barWidget.description: Camera mode, privacy, audio, gestures, pan/tilt/zoom, image controls and full presets for the EMEET PIXY; follows camera use and restores a preset on connect.

schema.label: emeet-pixyd client
schema.description: Name on PATH or absolute path of emeet-pixy / emeet-pixyd. ~/.nix-profile/bin and ~/.local/bin are searched too.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar polls the daemon while the panel is closed. The open panel polls every 2 seconds.

schema.label: Web UI URL
schema.description: Address of the daemon web UI (EMEET_PIXYD_WEB_ADDR).

schema.label: Follow camera use
schema.description: Open the lens (Meeting starts in) and switch to the preset's audio mode ~4s after an app uses the camera or microphone; privacy ~10s after it stops. Turns emeet-pixyd's own auto mode off.

schema.label: Meeting starts in
schema.description: Mode Follow camera use opens the lens in: track, or idle (Static), which returns to the last Static position.

schema.label: Start in Privacy mode
schema.description: Go into Privacy mode at login and whenever the camera is plugged in (it powers up out of Privacy mode). Needs Follow camera use.

schema.label: Seconds to Privacy mode after a meeting
schema.description: How long after the last app stops using the camera and microphone the camera goes into Privacy mode.

schema.label: Current preset
schema.description: The last preset picked in the panel. Panel changes save into it automatically; its image controls are restored at login and whenever the camera is plugged in, and its audio mode is used when a call starts.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: static-track: switch Static/Track; toggle-privacy: Privacy and back to the previous mode; web-ui: open the daemon web UI; none.
